details.description: Llama 3.1 Nemotron 70B Instruct is a 70.5-billion-parameter chat model that NVIDIA built by further training Meta's Llama 3.1 70B Instruct with the REINFORCE reinforcement-learning algorithm, using NVIDIA's own Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward model and HelpSteer2-Preference prompts. NVIDIA designed it to improve the helpfulness of the base model's responses to general-domain instructions, and states it has not been tuned for specialized domains such as math. On this catalog entry it has a 131,072-token context window.
advantages: NVIDIA reports an Arena Hard win rate of 85.0 against GPT-4-based judging, which it said ranked above GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet at release, per NVIDIA's model card.
NVIDIA reports an AlpacaEval 2 LC win rate of 57.6% against GPT-4, per NVIDIA's model card.
NVIDIA reports an MT-Bench score of 8.98 out of 10 judged by GPT-4-Turbo, per NVIDIA's model card.
NVIDIA highlights strength on nuanced reasoning tasks such as counting the occurrences of a letter within a word, per its model card.
disadvantages: NVIDIA states it has not been tuned for performance in specialized domains such as math, per its model card.
Fine-tuned from Meta's Llama 3.1 70B Instruct rather than a newer Llama generation.
use_cases: General-domain instruction following and helpful assistant responses

notes: Arena Hard, AlpacaEval and MT-Bench are preference/arena-judged scores, not 0-100 accuracy, so I put them in advantages rather than evaluations; I found no MMLU-style accuracy benchmarks on NVIDIA's model card. NVIDIA's card states 128,000 input tokens and a 4,000-token output limit, different from the catalog's 131,072/131,072; I kept the catalog's values per instructions. NVIDIA's card does not state supported languages, a knowledge cutoff, or whether this model has been superseded by a newer NVIDIA Nemotron release, so I left those out rather than guess.
